title: MK Shadowdark Crafting
description: A lightweight crafting and downtime module for Shadowdark RPG. Stores recipe books in world settings and creates real items only when crafted.

mk-module-hub.summary: A lightweight crafting and downtime module for Shadowdark RPG. Stores recipe books in world settings and creates real items only when crafted.
features: Crafting Panel from token controls, actor sheets, or macros
Recipe Books stored in world settings
GM recipe editor with crafting requirements
Ability checks with advantage and disadvantage
Search, sorting, Dense List, and Master Detail layouts
Output item creation from saved recipes
